_about: Defaults for standing_instructions.py, conversation.py and runtime_status.py (AGENTS.md Rule 0). Don't edit this file to change a value: copy the key into config.json under settings.runtime (same nesting) and change it there. runtime_config.py checks every value against the one here -- same type, numbers above 0, templates using only the {fields} used here -- and a bad one logs a line and falls back to this default.

standing_instructions._jobs: The jobs a fresh tray starts with (memory/standing_instructions.json takes over once it exists). Ids are the code's: task_review, project_review, downloads.

jobs.goal: Review open tasks and their deadlines. Suggest the next useful task; do not complete or create tasks.
Check the project's local Git status. Suggest one next engineering step from the evidence; do not change code or commit.
Sort quiet loose Downloads files using the existing type rules; preserve subfolders and collisions.

standing_instructions._min_every_seconds: Shortest interval a job may be set to, per job id; ids not listed use 'other'.

conversation._deflection_patterns: Regexes (case-insensitive) for replies that did nothing for him. Matching turns stay on disk but are left out of replay(). Patterns that don't compile are dropped with a log line.
conversation._noise_filler_words: A voice transcript made only of these words is answered but not recorded (looks_like_noise). Keep it to words that are never a request on their own.

runtime_status._stale_after_writes: The snapshot counts as stale (tray may be hung) after this many missed writes.

wording.no_status: no readable status ({error}) -- this tray predates runtime_status, or isn't running
wording.not_snapshot: the status file isn't a status snapshot
wording.exited: process {pid} isn't running -- the snapshot is from a tray that has exited
wording.stale: the snapshot is {age:.0f}s old -- the tray may be hung
wording.collect_error: the tray couldn't read its own state: {error}
wording.chat_busy: a reply is being worked on
